caseName: Weber v. Opera on Tour, Inc.
caseNameFull: Weber, President of the American Federation of Musicians v. Opera on Tour, Inc.
attorneys: Mr. William Macy for petitioners. Mr. Jack Lewis Kraus, II, for respondent.

opinions.text: It does not appear from the record that the federal question presented by the petition was necessarily decided by the Court of Appeals. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals of New York is denied. Lynch v. New York ex rel. Pierson, 293 U. S. 52; Honeyman v. Hanan, 300 U. S. 14, 18.
